name: Revelt Flandresca
source:
The leader of the Tenmon faction, and Renall's father.

[spoiler]He is actually a ruthless tyrant, who swapped the soul of his other daughter, Ionasal, with that of Yuuki Nei, a girl from Earth. He believes the Genom are "trash" and plans to wipe them out, along with anyone who doesn't see things his way.[/spoiler]
